  "explanation": "The request is accepted as an upward reserve-sizing study for SWPP with a 120-minute horizon and shortfall cost 40.0. Numerical outputs such as costs, coverage, and intervals are produced only by the verified numerical workflow.",
  "forbidden_variables": [
    "fabricated_result",

    "future_weather",
    "raw_data_modification",
    "realized_target",
    "test_period_residual"

    "task_type": "upward_reserve_sizing",
    "region_id": "SWPP",
    "horizon_minutes": 120,
    "cost_reserve": 1.0,
    "cost_shortfall": 40.0,
    "rolling_window": {
      "train_days": 730,
      "cal_days": 30,
      "test_days": 30,
      "rolling_step_days": 30
    },
    "requires_human_approval": true
  },
  "workflow": [
    "validate_request_against_allowed_task_region_horizon_and_cost",
    "construct_rolling_window_with_train_days_730_cal_days_30_test_days_30_step_days_30",
    "enforce_decision_time_variable_boundary_and_forbidden_variables",
    "run_verified_numerical_workflow_to_compute_costs_coverage_and_intervals",
    "record_numerical_outputs_and_audit_log",
    "require_human_approval_before_any_operational_use"
  ]
